```{r subset_wbm}
# --- 1. Subset WBM to Selected Climate Futures ---
scale_factor <- 0.015

# Historical period is assigned to all GCMs prior to 2024
wbm <- wbm_all %>%
  dplyr::left_join(selected_cfs %>% dplyr::select(CF, GCM), by = "GCM") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = ifelse(year(date) < 2026, "Historical", CF)) %>%
  drop_na(CF) %>%
  # Convert temperature and add runoff in volume units
  dplyr::mutate(
    tmean_F    = (9/5 * tmean_C) + 32,
    # whenever runoff is reported as volume, scale factor is applied
    runoff_cf  = (runoff_in_wbm / 12) * recharge_area_ft2 * scale_factor,
    runoff_gal = runoff_cf * cf_to_gal,
    runoff_gpm = runoff_gal / (60 * 24)
  )

setorder(wbm, date)
```

### 6. Projections

##### ---- Discharge Model

We calibrate a runoff routing model against observed Blowhard Spring
discharge, then apply it across all historical and future WBM runs. Three
versions of the routing model are run — central, lower, and upper bounds —
by scaling the WBM runoff input and adjusting the slow-flow storage fraction
parameter (`vs`).

```{r discharge_model}
# --- 1. Calibration Data (Historical Period Only) ---
# Use the first ~5 years for model calibration
mod_dat <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) < 1985) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, runoff_gpm) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 2. Run Central, Min, and Max Routing Models ---
# Central estimate: calibrated scale factor and vs
springflow <- run_routing_gw(mod_dat, runoff_col = "runoff_gpm", vs = 0.3) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(blowhard_spr, by = "date")

# Lower bound: 0.5× runoff scale, lower vs
springflow_min <- run_routing_gw(
    mod_dat %>% dplyr::mutate(runoff_gpm = 0.5 * runoff_gpm),
    runoff_col = "runoff_gpm", vs = 0.2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(blowhard_spr, by = "date")

# Upper bound: 1.5× runoff scale, higher vs
springflow_max <- run_routing_gw(
    mod_dat %>% dplyr::mutate(runoff_gpm = 1.5 * runoff_gpm),
    runoff_col = "runoff_gpm", vs = 0.5
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(blowhard_spr, by = "date")

# --- 3. Compile and Plot Calibration Results ---
springflow_plot <- springflow %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Q_tot_min        = springflow_min$Q_tot,
    Q_tot_max        = springflow_max$Q_tot
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(annual_mean_Q_tot = mean(Q_tot, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(springflow_plot, aes(x = date)) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = as.Date("1983-01-01"), xmax = as.Date("1984-01-01"),
                ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Q_tot_min, ymax = Q_tot_max),
              fill = pal$lightblue, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Q_tot), color = "black",       linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = Q_tot, color = "Modeled"),      linewidth = 1,   lineend = "round") +
  geom_point(aes(y = flow_gpm, color = "Observed"), size = 2, shape = 21, fill = pal$darkblue) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Flow (gpm)") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c(pal$lightblue, "black", pal$lightblue))

# --- 4. Model Performance Statistics ---
# Remove 1983 (duplicate of 1982 — data error)
rm_bd_yrs <- springflow %>%
  dplyr::filter(!year(date) %in% c(1983)) %>%
  drop_na(flow_gpm, Q_tot) %>%
  dplyr::select(flow_gpm, Q_tot)

NSE(sim = rm_bd_yrs$flow_gpm, obs = rm_bd_yrs$Q_tot)

# Linear fit of observed vs. predicted (exclude 1980 and 1983)
model <- lm(Q_tot ~ flow_gpm,
            data = springflow %>% dplyr::filter(!year(date) %in% c(1980, 1983)))
summary(model)$r.squared

ggplot(springflow %>% dplyr::filter(!year(date) %in% c(1980, 1983)),
       aes(x = flow_gpm, y = Q_tot)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  theme_bw()

# --- 5. Apply Routing Model to Full WBM Dataset ---
# Scale factors and vs parameters correspond to central, low, and high bounds
wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  data.table() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GCM) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    runoff_gpm_low  = 0.5 * runoff_gpm,
    runoff_gpm_high = 1.5 * runoff_gpm,
    discharge_gpm   = run_routing_gw(
                        data.table(date, runoff_gpm),
                        runoff_col = "runoff_gpm", vs = 0.3,
                        return_components = FALSE
                      )[, 2],
    discharge_gpm_low = run_routing_gw(
                        data.table(date, runoff_gpm_low),
                        runoff_col = "runoff_gpm_low", vs = 0.2,
                        return_components = FALSE
                      )[, 2],
    discharge_gpm_high = run_routing_gw(
                        data.table(date, runoff_gpm_high),
                        runoff_col = "runoff_gpm_high", vs = 0.5,
                        return_components = FALSE
                      )[, 2]
  ) %>%
  # Convert discharge from gpm to cubic feet per day
  dplyr::mutate(
    discharge_cf      = discharge_gpm      * gal_to_cf * 60 * 24,
    discharge_cf_low  = discharge_gpm_low  * gal_to_cf * 60 * 24,
    discharge_cf_high = discharge_gpm_high * gal_to_cf * 60 * 24
  )



# --- 6. Annual and Monthly Aggregations ---
mean_cols <- c("soil_in_wbm", "tmean_C", "runoff_cfs_wbm", "tmean_F", "runoff_gpm",
               "discharge_gpm", "discharge_gpm_low", "discharge_gpm_high")

wbm_annual <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = calc_water_year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Rank, Region, RCP, Skill, date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, GCM, CF, name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(all_of(mean_cols),                          \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(where(is.numeric) & !all_of(mean_cols),     \(x) sum(x,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wbm_monthly <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ym = make_ym(date)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(Rank, Region, RCP, Skill, date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ym, GCM, CF, name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    across(all_of(mean_cols), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    across(everything(),      \(x) sum(x,  na.rm = TRUE))
  )

rm(wbm_all)
gc()
```

##### ---- Visitation

Historical NPS visitation data from IRMA, summarized to annual totals and
monthly mean proportions.

```{r visitation_data}
# --- 1. Download Monthly Visitor Counts ---
visitors <- getUnitVisitation(units = park, startYear = 1979, endYear = 2024) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ym             = lubridate::ym(paste0(Year, "-", Month)),
    TotalVisitors  = RecreationVisitors + NonRecreationVisitors
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ym, TotalVisitors) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    TotalVisitors = ifelse(TotalVisitors == 0, NA, TotalVisitors),
    month         = month(ym)
  )

# --- 2. Annual Totals ---
visitors_an <- visitors %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(ym)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(ym, month)) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(.funs = sum)

# --- 3. Monthly Summary Statistics ---
# Mean, max, min, SD, CV, and fraction-of-annual for each calendar month
monthly_visitor_proportions <- visitors %>%
  dplyr::group_by(month) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    TV_mean = mean(TotalVisitors, na.rm = TRUE),
    TV_max  = max(TotalVisitors,  na.rm = TRUE),
    TV_min  = min(TotalVisitors,  na.rm = TRUE),
    TV_sd   = sd(TotalVisitors,   na.rm = TRUE),
    TV_cv   = TV_sd / TV_mean
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = as_date(paste0("2000-", month, "-01")),
    fraction   = TV_mean / sum(TV_mean)
  )

# --- 4. Exploratory Plots ---
ggarrange(
  ggplot(visitors_an, aes(x = year, y = TotalVisitors)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() + geom_smooth() +
    labs(y = "Annual Total Visitors") + theme_bw(),
  ggplot(monthly_visitor_proportions, aes(x = month, y = TV_mean)) +
    geom_line() + geom_point() +
    labs(y = "Monthly Mean Total Visitors") + theme_bw()
)
```

National Park visitation is driven by many factors, including overall
population growth and weather. Here we fit logistic models to account for a
visitor carrying capacity, and then build a GAM that adds weather sensitivity.

```{r logistic}
# --- 1. Define Carrying Capacity Scenarios ---
# True carrying capacity is unknown and likely variable; we test three values
K_limit_low  <- 800000
K_limit_mid  <- 1250000
K_limit_high <- 1500000

# Logistic growth model: K / (1 + exp(-r * (year - t0)))
logistic_mod <- function(K_limit, r, t0, year) {
  K_limit / (1 + exp(-r * (year - t0)))
}

# Fit NLS logistic model for a given K; returns fitted nls object
fit_vis_logistic <- function(K_limit, df) {
  nls(
    TotalVisitors ~ logistic_mod(K_limit, r, t0, year),
    data  = df,
    start = list(r = 0.05, t0 = 2010)
  )
}

# --- 2. Fit Logistic Models for Low, Mid, and High K ---
vis_logistic_low  <- fit_vis_logistic(K_limit_low,  visitors_an)
vis_logistic_mid  <- fit_vis_logistic(K_limit_mid,  visitors_an)
vis_logistic_high <- fit_vis_logistic(K_limit_high, visitors_an)

# --- 3. Project to 2100 ---
future_years <- data.frame(year = 1980:2100) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pred_vis_low  = predict(vis_logistic_low,  newdata = .),
    pred_vis_mid  = predict(vis_logistic_mid,  newdata = .),
    pred_vis_high = predict(vis_logistic_high, newdata = .)
  )

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = visitors_an,  aes(x = year, y = TotalVisitors, color = "Obs.")) +
  geom_ribbon(data = future_years, aes(x = year, ymin = pred_vis_low, ymax = pred_vis_high), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(data = future_years,   aes(x = year, y = pred_vis_mid, color = "mod")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1200000, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Total Visitors", title = "Logistic Model with Visitor Ceiling") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("black", "red"))
```

```{r monthly_vis_model}
# --- 1. Prepare Monthly Training Data ---
# Join WBM climate to visitor counts and add lagged temperature predictors
vis_mod_dat_monthly <- visitors %>%
  left_join(wbm_monthly %>% dplyr::filter(GCM == "GridMET"), by = "ym") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    year          = year(ym),
    pop           = logistic_mod(K_limit_mid,
                                 coef(vis_logistic_mid)["r"],
                                 coef(vis_logistic_mid)["t0"],
                                 year),
    tmean_F_prev  = dplyr::lag(tmean_F, 1),
    tmean_F_prev2 = frollmean(tmean_F, 2, align = "right")
  )

# --- 2. Fit Monthly GAM ---
vis_mod_monthly <- mgcv::gam(
  TotalVisitors ~ pop + tmean_F + tmean_F_prev + snow_in_wbm,
  data = vis_mod_dat_monthly
)

# --- 3. Add Predictions and Residuals ---
vis_mod_dat_monthly <- vis_mod_dat_monthly %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pred_vis          = predict(vis_mod_monthly, newdata = .),
    pred_vis          = ifelse(pred_vis < 0, 0, pred_vis),
    pred_vis_residual = TotalVisitors - pred_vis
  )

# --- 4. Aggregate to Annual for Cross-Scale Evaluation ---
vis_mod_dat_m_an <- vis_mod_dat_monthly %>%
  dplyr::select(year, TotalVisitors, pred_vis) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    TotalVisitors     = sum(TotalVisitors, na.rm = TRUE),
    pred_vis          = sum(pred_vis,      na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pred_vis_residual = TotalVisitors - pred_vis) %>%
  dplyr::filter(pred_vis != 0)

# --- 5. Model Performance Statistics ---
monthly_R2 <- round(summary(vis_mod_monthly)$r.sq, 2)
annual_R2  <- round(
  summary(lm(pred_vis ~ TotalVisitors, data = vis_mod_dat_m_an))$r.sq, 2
)

# --- 6. Performance Diagnostics Panel ---
ggarrange(
  # Monthly time series
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat_monthly) +
    geom_line(aes(x = ym, y = TotalVisitors, color = "Observed"), lwd = 0.5) +
    geom_line(aes(x = ym, y = pred_vis,      color = "Modeled"),  lwd = 0.5) +
    theme_bw() +
    annotate("text",
      label = as.character(as.expression(bquote(R^2 == .(monthly_R2)))),
      parse = TRUE, x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
      size = 4, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(x = "", y = "Monthly Visitors", title = "Monthly GAM") +
    scale_color_manual("", values = c("tomato", "black")),
  # Annual aggregated time series
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat_m_an, aes(x = year)) +
    geom_line(aes(y = TotalVisitors, color = "Observed"), lwd = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(y = pred_vis,      color = "Modeled"),  lwd = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    annotate("text",
      label = as.character(as.expression(bquote(R^2 == .(annual_R2)))),
      parse = TRUE, x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
      size = 4, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(title = "Aggregated Monthly GAM to Annual") +
    scale_color_manual("", values = c("tomato", "black")),
  # Residuals over time
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat_monthly, aes(x = ym, y = pred_vis_residual)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_line() +
    labs(y = "Residual (# visitors)", x = "", title = "Residuals") +
    theme_bw(),
  # 1:1 accuracy
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat_monthly, aes(x = TotalVisitors, y = pred_vis)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    theme_bw() +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "Observed Monthly Visitors", y = "Modeled Monthly Visitors",
         title = "1:1 Accuracy"),
  align = "hv"
)
```

```{r annual_vis_model}
# --- 1. Prepare Annual Training Data ---
vis_mod_dat <- visitors_an %>%
  left_join(
    clim_hist %>%
      dplyr::mutate(year = year(date), tmean_F = (tmean_C * 9/5) + 32) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(tmean_F = mean(tmean_F), prcp = mean(ppt_mm)),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pop          = logistic_mod(K_limit_mid,
                                coef(vis_logistic_mid)["r"],
                                coef(vis_logistic_mid)["t0"],
                                year),
    tmean_F_prev = dplyr::lag(tmean_F, 1)
  )

# --- 2. Fit Annual GAM ---
vis_mod <- mgcv::gam(TotalVisitors ~ year + tmean_F + pop, data = vis_mod_dat)

# --- 3. Generate Predictions and Residuals ---
vis_mod_dat <- vis_mod_dat %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pred_vis          = predict(vis_mod, newdata = .),
    pred_vis          = ifelse(pred_vis < 0, 0, pred_vis),
    pred_vis_residual = TotalVisitors - pred_vis
  )

# --- 4. Model Performance Statistics ---
r2_val <- round(summary(vis_mod)$r.sq, 2)
p_val  <- format.pval(mean(summary(vis_mod)$p.pv), digits = 2, eps = 0.001)

# --- 5. Diagnostic Visualization ---
annual_vis_mod_plot <- ggarrange(
  # Panel A: Time Series
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat) +
    geom_line(aes(x = year, y = TotalVisitors, color = "Observed"), size = 1) +
    geom_line(aes(x = year, y = pred_vis,      color = "Modeled"),  size = 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    annotate("text",
      label = as.character(as.expression(bquote(R^2 == .(r2_val) ~~~ p < .(p_val)))),
      parse = TRUE, x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
      size = 4, fontface = "italic") +
    labs(x = "Year", y = "Annual Visitors", title = "Annual Model Performance") +
    scale_color_manual("", values = c("Modeled" = "tomato", "Observed" = "black")),
  # Panel B: Residuals over time
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat, aes(x = year, y = pred_vis_residual)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
    geom_line() + geom_point() +
    labs(y = "Residual (# visitors)", x = "Year", title = "Annual Residuals") +
    theme_bw(),
  # Panel C: 1:1 Accuracy
  ggplot(vis_mod_dat, aes(x = TotalVisitors, y = pred_vis)) +
    geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dotted", size = 1) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    theme_bw() + coord_equal() +
    labs(x = "Observed Annual Visitors", y = "Modeled Annual Visitors",
         title = "1:1 Accuracy"),
  ncol  = 1,
  align = "v"
)

ggsave(plot     = annual_vis_mod_plot,
       filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/Annual_vis_mod.tiff",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 5)
```

The annual model outperforms the aggregated monthly model for annual estimates,
so it is used for future projections.

```{r compare_models}
# --- 1. Compile Both Model Predictions ---
comparison_df <- vis_mod_dat_m_an %>%
  dplyr::rename(pred_monthly_agg = pred_vis) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(vis_mod_dat %>% dplyr::select(year, pred_annual = pred_vis), by = "year")

# --- 2. Error Metrics Function ---
get_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  c(RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE  = mean(abs(obs - pred),     na.rm = TRUE))
}

# --- 3. Comparison Table ---
model_comparison <- data.frame(
  Metric             = c("RMSE (Visitors)", "MAE (Visitors)"),
  Monthly_Aggregated = get_metrics(comparison_df$TotalVisitors, comparison_df$pred_monthly_agg),
  Annual_Direct      = get_metrics(comparison_df$TotalVisitors, comparison_df$pred_annual)
)

print(model_comparison)

# --- 4. Visual Comparison ---
ggplot(comparison_df) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = TotalVisitors,   color = "Observed"),          size = 1.2) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = pred_monthly_agg, color = "Monthly-Aggregated"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = pred_annual,      color = "Annual-Direct"),     linetype = "dotted") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("Observed" = "black",
                                    "Monthly-Aggregated" = "tomato",
                                    "Annual-Direct"      = "dodgerblue")) +
  labs(title    = "Model Comparison: Aggregated Monthly vs. Direct Annual",
       subtitle = "Which model better captures historical extremes?",
       y = "Total Annual Visitors", x = "Year") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r proj_vis}
# --- 1. Project Visitation Under Future Climate ---
vis_clim <- wbm_annual %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pop = logistic_mod(K_limit_mid,
                                   coef(vis_logistic_mid)["r"],
                                   coef(vis_logistic_mid)["t0"],
                                   year)) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, pop, tmean_F, GCM, CF) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(GCM, CF) %>%
  dplyr::group_modify(~ {
    preds <- predict(vis_mod, newdata = .x, se.fit = TRUE)
    .x %>% mutate(vis_pred    = as.numeric(preds$fit),
                  vis_pred_SE = as.numeric(preds$se.fit))
  }) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    vis_pred_low  = vis_pred - (vis_pred_SE * 1.96),
    vis_pred_high = vis_pred + (vis_pred_SE * 1.96)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    vis_yearly_max  = max(vis_pred_high),
    vis_yearly_min  = min(vis_pred_low),
    vis_yearly_mean = mean(c(vis_pred_high, vis_pred_low), na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# View GAM predictions with uncertainty bounds
ggplot(vis_clim, aes(x = year, fill = CF, color = CF)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = vis_pred)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = vis_pred_low, ymax = vis_pred_high), alpha = 0.3, lwd = 0) +
  geom_point(data = visitors_an %>% dplyr::mutate(CF = "Observed"),
             aes(x = year, y = TotalVisitors)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual Visitors") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c(nps_pal$red, nps_pal$grey, "black", nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_fill_manual("",  values = c(nps_pal$red, nps_pal$grey, "black", nps_pal$blue))

# --- 2. Fit Smooth Logistic Envelope Over GAM Predictions ---
# Re-fit logistic to smooth the noisy year-to-year GAM output
fit_smooth_logistic <- function(y_var, df, K) {
  nls(y_var ~ logistic_mod(K, r, t0, year),
      data  = df,
      start = list(r = 0.05, t0 = 2050))
}

log_mod_proj <- fit_smooth_logistic(vis_clim$vis_yearly_mean, vis_clim, max(vis_clim$vis_yearly_mean))
log_mod_high <- fit_smooth_logistic(vis_clim$vis_yearly_max,  vis_clim, max(vis_clim$vis_yearly_max))
log_mod_low  <- fit_smooth_logistic(vis_clim$vis_yearly_min,  vis_clim, max(vis_clim$vis_yearly_min))

vis_clim <- vis_clim %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    vis_smooth_mid  = as.numeric(predict(log_mod_proj, newdata = .)),
    vis_smooth_high = as.numeric(predict(log_mod_high, newdata = .)),
    vis_smooth_low  = as.numeric(predict(log_mod_low,  newdata = .))
  ) %>%
  left_join(visitors_an %>% dplyr::select(year, TotalVisitors), by = "year") 

# --- 3. Project Future Monthly Visitor Proportions ---
proj_vis_sum <- vis_clim %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(year > 2034, year < 2065) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    mean_vis = mean(vis_smooth_mid),
    max_vis  = max(vis_smooth_high),
    min_vis  = min(vis_smooth_low)
  )

monthly_visitor_proportions <- monthly_visitor_proportions %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    fut_min_vis  = proj_vis_sum$min_vis  * fraction,
    fut_max_vis  = proj_vis_sum$max_vis  * fraction,
    fut_mean_vis = proj_vis_sum$mean_vis * fraction
  )
```

##### ---- Water Use

No state-reported water use records are available for CEBR. Water use is
therefore estimated from visitation data using low, mid, and high
per-visitor use rates drawn from published values.

```{r water_use}
# NOTE: No valid WRID — no reported use data for CEBR.
# Code to pull state-reported data is retained below but commented out.

# water_supply_id <- getWaterSuppliersUtah(aoi = park_boundary %>% st_buffer(1000)) %>%
#   filter(grepl("National", WRNAME, ignore.case = TRUE) | ...) %>% .$water_supply_id

# --- 1. Define Per-Visitor Use Rates (in cubic feet) ---
# Sources: published ranges; Hughes (1996) for low estimate
high_use_per_visitor <- 2.5 * gal_to_cf      # ~2.5 gal/visitor (high range)
low_use_per_visitor  <- 0.83828345 * gal_to_cf # historical observed rate (Hughes, 1996)
mid_use_per_visitor  <- (high_use_per_visitor + low_use_per_visitor) / 2

# --- 2. Monthly Use Proportions (in cubic feet) ---
monthly_use_proportions <- monthly_visitor_proportions %>%
  dplyr::select(month, month_date, TV_mean, fut_mean_vis) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mid_use_hist  = TV_mean      * mid_use_per_visitor,
    mid_use_fut   = fut_mean_vis * mid_use_per_visitor,
    low_use_hist  = TV_mean      * low_use_per_visitor,
    low_use_fut   = fut_mean_vis * low_use_per_visitor,
    high_use_hist = TV_mean      * high_use_per_visitor,
    high_use_fut  = fut_mean_vis * high_use_per_visitor,
    use_fraction  = mid_use_hist / sum(mid_use_hist)
  )

# --- 3. Annual Use Estimates ---
# For historical years, use observed visitation; for future, use smooth logistic projection
annual_use <- vis_clim %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mid_vis  = ifelse(year < 2025, TotalVisitors, vis_smooth_mid),
    low_vis  = ifelse(year < 2025, TotalVisitors, vis_smooth_low),
    high_vis = ifelse(year < 2025, TotalVisitors, vis_smooth_high)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(year, tmean_F, mid_vis, low_vis, high_vis) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mid_use  = mid_vis  * mid_use_per_visitor,
    low_use  = mid_vis  * low_use_per_visitor,
    high_use = mid_vis  * high_use_per_visitor,
    c_group  = ifelse(year <= 2024, "Historical", "Projected")
  )

# --- 4. Distribute Annual Use to Monthly Proportions ---
monthly_use <- annual_use %>%
  full_join(
    data.frame(ym = seq.Date(from = as.Date("1979-01-01"),
                             to   = as.Date("2100-12-01"), by = "month")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(year = year(ym)),
    by = "year"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(month = month(ym)) %>%
  left_join(monthly_use_proportions %>% dplyr::select(month, use_fraction)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    monthly_use_mid  = use_fraction * mid_use,
    monthly_use_high = use_fraction * high_use,
    monthly_use_low  = use_fraction * low_use
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(ym, monthly_use_low, monthly_use_high, monthly_use_mid) %>%
  full_join(
    wbm_monthly %>% dplyr::select(ym, discharge_cf, discharge_cf_low,
                                  discharge_cf_high, CF),
    by = "ym"
  )

# Spot-check use at key future years
use_2024_2050_2070 <- annual_use %>%
  dplyr::filter(year %in% c(2024, 2050, 2070)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    use_mid  = mean(mid_use),
    use_high = mean(high_use),
    low_use  = mean(low_use)
  )
```

##### ---- Supply: Calculate Monthly Supply and Demand

```{r supply_demand}
# --- 1. Monthly Supply Proportions ---
# Aggregate daily discharge to monthly totals per CF; then compute mean
# historical and future monthly supply and its fractional distribution
monthly_supply_proportions <- wbm %>%
  select(CF, date, discharge_cf) %>%
  mutate(ym = make_ym(date)) %>%
  group_by(ym, CF, GCM) %>%
  summarize(discharge_cf = sum(discharge_cf, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    month = month(ym),
    year  = year(ym),
    group = case_when(
      year <= 2012                      ~ "Historical",
      year > 2034 & year < 2070        ~ "Future",
      TRUE                              ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  drop_na(group) %>%
  group_by(month, CF) %>%
  summarize(
    monthly_supply_cf     = mean(discharge_cf, na.rm = TRUE),
    monthly_supply_cf_max = max(discharge_cf,  na.rm = TRUE),
    monthly_supply_cf_min = min(discharge_cf,  na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    month_date       = as_date(paste0("2000-", month, "-01")),
    month_days       = days_in_month(month_date)
  ) %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cf         = sum(monthly_supply_cf),
    monthly_fraction = monthly_supply_cf / total_cf
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- 2. Monthly Demand (Long Format) ---
monthly_use_long <- monthly_use_proportions %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = matches("(mid|low|high)_use_(fut|hist)"),
    names_to  = "use_cat",
    values_to = "use_cf"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Offset dates for historical vs. future panel visualization
    month_date = case_when(
      grepl("hist", use_cat) ~ month_date - years(4),
      TRUE                   ~ month_date + years(50)
    ),
    new_group = case_when(
      grepl("low",  use_cat) ~ "low_use",
      grepl("high", use_cat) ~ "high_use",
      TRUE                   ~ "mid_use"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(month_date, new_group, use_cf) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = new_group, values_from = use_cf)

# --- 3. Demand-to-Supply (D-S) Ratio ---
DS_df <- wbm_annual %>%
  select(year, CF, discharge_cf) %>%
  left_join(annual_use, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    DS          = mid_use  / discharge_cf,
    DS_stress   = high_use / discharge_cf,
    DS_over_pt2 = if_else(DS >= 0.2, 1, 0),
    DS_over_1   = if_else(DS >= 1,   1, 0)
  )

# --- 4. Period-Summary Statistics ---
DS_stats <- DS_df %>%
  filter(
    (year >= 1980 & year <= 2012) |
    (year >= 2035 & year <= 2064)
  ) %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  summarize(
    n                       = n(),
    high_stress_years       = 100 * sum(DS_over_pt2) / n,
    inadequate_supply_years = 100 * sum(DS_over_1)   / n,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(DS_stats)
```

### 7. Fire

```{r fire}
# --- 1. Historical Fire Perimeters ---
fire_aoi      <- park_boundary %>% st_buffer(5000)
new_geomac    <- sf::st_read(
  "data/all/InterAgencyFirePerimeterHistory_All_Years_View/InterAgencyFirePerimeterHistory_All_Years_View.shp"
)
park_new_geomac <- new_geomac %>%
  sf::st_filter(., st_transform(park_boundary %>% st_buffer(5000),
                                crs = st_crs(new_geomac)))

# --- 2. Land Cover (NLCD 2021) in Recharge Area ---
nlcd_path <- "data/all/nlcd_2021_land_cover_l48_20230630/nlcd_2021_land_cover_l48_20230630.img"
nlcd <- terra::rast(nlcd_path) %>%
  terra::crop(., st_transform(recharge_aoi, crs = crs(terra::rast(nlcd_path))),
              mask = TRUE) %>%
  droplevels()

# Forest classes: 41 = Deciduous, 42 = Evergreen, 43 = Mixed Forest
forest_mask <- nlcd %in% c(41, 42, 43)

# Fraction of park and recharge area that is forested
nlcd_crs <- crs(terra::rast(nlcd_path))
park_forested_fraction    <- terra::zonal(forest_mask,
  terra::vect(st_transform(park_boundary, nlcd_crs)),
  fun = "mean", weights = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

recharge_aoi_fraction     <- terra::zonal(forest_mask,
  terra::vect(st_transform(recharge_aoi, nlcd_crs)),
  fun = "mean", weights = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

# --- 3. Burned Fraction of Recharge Area ---
burned_fraction_of_watershed <- park_new_geomac %>%
  dplyr::summarize() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(recharge_aoi)) %>%
  st_intersection(recharge_aoi) %>%
  st_area() %>%
  `/`(st_area(recharge_aoi)) %>%
  as.numeric()
```

Fire exposure is estimated using the PC2FM model from Gao et al. (2021):

> Gao, P., et al. (2021). Robust projections of future fire probability for
> the conterminous United States. *Science of The Total Environment, 789*,
> 147872. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.scitotenv.2021.147872>

```{r fire_exposure}
# --- 1. Identify Water Supply Pyrome ---
aoi <- recharge_aoi %>% st_buffer(500)

water_supply_pyromes <- st_read(
    "data/all/usfs_fire/Pyromes-RDS-2020-0020/Data/Pyromes_CONUS_20200206.shp"
  ) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  sf::st_transform(st_crs(aoi)) %>%
  sf::st_filter(., aoi)

# Cedar Breaks falls within the Far Southern Rockies pyrome
mapview(water_supply_pyromes, zcol = "NAME",
        col.regions = pal$gold, alpha.regions = 0.3) +
  mapview(park_boundary, col.regions = pal$lightblue)

# --- 2. Load Gao 2021 Fire Probability Data ---
crosswalk        <- read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/gcm_crosswalk.csv")
fireprob_historic <- read_csv(
    "data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021/tables3-fireprob-hist.csv"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(PYROME, GridMet)

# Mid-century (2040–2070) delta fire probability for both RCPs
all_delta_fireprob <- read_csv(
    "data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021//tables12-45-midcentury.csv"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao") %>%
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") %>%
  mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp45")) %>%
  bind_rows(
    read_csv("data/all/usfs_fire/fire_projections_gao_2021//tables6-85-midcentury.csv") %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-PYROME, names_to = "gao", values_to = "value") %>%
      left_join(crosswalk, by = "gao") %>%
      mutate(GCM = paste0(GCM, ".rcp85"))
  ) %>%
  left_join(fireprob_historic, by = "PYROME") %>%
  # Delta FP: percentage change relative to historical baseline
  mutate(delta_fp = 100 * ((value - GridMet) / GridMet)) %>%
  left_join(future_differentials, by = "GCM") %>%
  dplyr::filter(PYROME %in% water_supply_pyromes$PYROME)

delta_fireprob <- all_delta_fireprob %>%
  filter(GCM %in% selected_gcms[[1]]$GCM) %>%
  left_join(selected_gcms[[1]], by = "GCM")

# --- 3. Fire Probability vs. Runoff Correlation ---
fpr <- ggplot(all_delta_fireprob, aes(x = mean_runoff_in, y = delta_fp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = GCM)) +
  geom_point(
    data = delta_fireprob %>% dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Warm Wet", "Hot Dry")),
    aes(x = mean_runoff_in, y = delta_fp),
    shape = 1, size = 5
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Projected Mean Annual Runoff (in)",
       y = "Delta Fire Probability (Gao et al., 2021)")

fpr
ggsave("data/park/CEBR/Figs/fire_prob_runoff_corr.jpg",
       plot = fpr, dpi = 600, height = 5, width = 8, units = "in")
```

Fire sensitivity is characterized using the Wildfire Hazard Potential (WHP)
dataset:

> Dillon, G. K. (2023). Wildfire Hazard Potential for the United States
> (270-m), version 2023. 4th Edition. USDA Forest Service Research Data
> Archive. <https://doi.org/10.2737/RDS-2015-0047-4>

```{r WHP}
# --- 1. Continuous WHP — Percentile Ranking in Water Supply Pyrome ---
whp_cnt <- terra::rast("data/all/usfs_fire/whp2023_GeoTIF/whp2023_cnt_conus.tif") %>%
  terra::crop(., sf::st_transform(water_supply_pyromes, 5070),
              mask = TRUE, touches = TRUE) %>%
  na.omit()

# Convert raw WHP values to percentile ranks (1% intervals)
values    <- terra::values(whp_cnt, na.rm = TRUE)
quantiles <- quantile(values, probs = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01)) %>%
  tibble::as_tibble() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(to = c(lead(value, 1))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(to = ifelse(is.na(to), max(values) + 1, to)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(from = value) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(becomes = seq(0, 1, by = 0.01))

whp_quantiled <- terra::classify(whp_cnt, rcl = quantiles, right = TRUE)

# Area-weighted mean percentile within the water supply recharge area
water_supply_fire_potential <- whp_quantiled %>%
  crop(sf::st_transform(aoi, 5070), mask = TRUE)

mean_fire_potential <- terra::zonal(
  water_supply_fire_potential,
  terra::vect(sf::st_transform(aoi, 5070)),
  fun = "mean", weights = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE
)
```

```{r percent_whp}
# --- 1. Categorical WHP —  Fraction "High" or Better in Water Supply Area ---
whp_conus_cls <- terra::rast("data/all/usfs_fire/whp2023_GeoTIF/whp2023_cls_conus.tif")

plot(whp_conus_cls)

whp_park_cls <- whp_conus_cls %>%
  terra::crop(., sf::st_transform(aoi, 5070), mask = TRUE, touches = TRUE) %>%
  terra::na.omit()

reclass      <- cats(whp_park_cls)[[1]] %>%
  dplyr::mutate(class_short = str_sub(cats(whp_park_cls)[[1]][, 2], 4))

whp_park_cls <- categories(whp_park_cls, layer = 1, value = reclass, active = 2)

high_mask        <- whp_park_cls %in% c(4, 5)
high_medium_mask <- whp_park_cls %in% c(3, 4, 5)

# Fraction of "High" pixels in the watershed (area-weighted)
high_mask_numeric <- classify(high_mask, cbind(TRUE, 1), cbind(FALSE, 0)) %>%
  terra::zonal(., terra::vect(sf::st_transform(aoi, 5070)),
               fun = "mean", weights = TRUE, na.rm = TRUE)

plot(classify(high_mask, cbind(TRUE, 1), cbind(FALSE, 0)))
```

### 8. Drought (SPEI)

SPEI is calculated using the P − PET water balance from the WBM. The
`ag_n` parameter controls the aggregation window (e.g., 6 = 6-month SPEI).

```{r spei}
# --- 1. Aggregate WBM to SPEI Time Scale ---
ag_n       <- 6                                      # Aggregation window (months)
freq       <- 12 / ag_n                              # Frequency for ts() object
agg_months <- ifelse(ag_n == 1, paste0(ag_n, " month"), paste0(ag_n, " months"))

agg_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    year    = year(date),
    month   = month(date),
    time_ag = floor_date(date, agg_months)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year, time_ag, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    precip_in_wbm  = sum(precip_in_wbm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    tmean_C        = mean(tmean_C,        na.rm = TRUE),
    pet_in_wbm     = sum(pet_in_wbm,     na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff_in_wbm  = sum(runoff_in_wbm,  na.rm = TRUE),
    discharge_gpm  = mean(discharge_gpm, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    balance = precip_in_wbm - pet_in_wbm,
    month   = month(time_ag)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

end_year  <- agg_wbm$year  %>% tail(n = 1)
end_month <- agg_wbm$month %>% tail(n = 1)

# --- 2. Calculate SPEI for Each Climate Future ---
# Hot Dry and Historical are combined, then Warm Wet and Historical,
# so SPEI is referenced to the same historical baseline in each case.
spei_drier <- agg_wbm %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Historical", "Drier")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    spei = c(spei(ts(c(balance), end = c(end_year, end_month), frequency = freq),
                  scale   = freq,
                  ref.end = c(2023, 1))[["fitted"]]),
    ym   = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"))
  )

spei_wetter <- agg_wbm %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Historical", "Wetter")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    spei = c(spei(ts(balance, end = c(end_year, end_month), frequency = freq),
                  scale   = freq,
                  ref.end = c(2023, 1))[["fitted"]]),
    ym   = as.Date(paste0(year, "-", month, "-01"))
  )

# Combine: use Drier future only for post-2023 years
spei <- bind_rows(
  spei_drier  %>% dplyr::filter(year >= 2024),
  spei_wetter
)

# --- 3. Drought Severity Statistics ---
spei_severity <- spei %>%
  dplyr::filter(year < 2065) %>%
  drop_na(spei) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    moderate = spei <= -1,
    severe   = spei <= -1.5,
    extreme  = spei <= -2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n            = n(),
    mod_percent  = 100 * sum(moderate, na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    sev_percent  = 100 * sum(severe,   na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    ext_percent  = 100 * sum(extreme,  na.rm = TRUE) / n,
    mean_spei    = mean(spei),
    median_spei  = median(spei, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_spei      = sd(spei,     na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# --- 4. Drought Event Frequency and Duration ---
spei_frequency <- spei %>%
  drop_na(spei) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    moderate  = spei <= -1,
    severe    = spei <= -1.5,
    extreme   = spei <= -2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    mod_event = cumsum(moderate & !lag(moderate, default = FALSE)),
    sev_event = cumsum(severe   & !lag(severe,   default = FALSE)),
    ext_event = cumsum(extreme  & !lag(extreme,  default = FALSE))
  )

# Summarize event-level duration and intensity for moderate, severe, and extreme
spei_metrics <- left_join(
  spei_frequency %>%
    dplyr::filter(moderate) %>%
    group_by(CF, mod_event) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(duration = n(), mean_spei = mean(spei, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      mod_mean_duration   = mean(duration,   na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      mod_max_duration    = max(duration,    na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      mod_median_duration = median(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      mod_mean_spei       = mean(mean_spei,  na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
  spei_frequency %>%
    dplyr::filter(severe) %>%
    group_by(CF, sev_event) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(duration = n(), mean_spei = mean(spei, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      sev_mean_duration   = mean(duration,   na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      sev_max_duration    = max(duration,    na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      sev_median_duration = median(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
      sev_mean_spei       = mean(mean_spei,  na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
  by = "CF"
) %>%
  left_join(
    spei_frequency %>%
      dplyr::filter(extreme) %>%
      group_by(CF, ext_event) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(duration = n(), mean_spei = mean(spei, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(
        ext_mean_duration   = mean(duration,   na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
        ext_max_duration    = max(duration,    na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
        ext_median_duration = median(duration, na.rm = TRUE) / freq,
        ext_mean_spei       = mean(mean_spei,  na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
    by = "CF"
  ) %>%
  left_join(spei_severity, by = "CF") %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame(stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  row_to_names(row_number = 1) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Metric") %>%
  arrange(Metric)

# Exploratory: SPEI vs. discharge relationship (July)
ggplot(spei %>% dplyr::filter(month(ym) == 7),
       aes(x = spei, y = discharge_gpm)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(fill = "orange", color = "maroon", alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "SPEI", y = "Mean Discharge (GPM)")
```

### 9. Cold Days

Freeze frequency (days with tmin ≤ 0°C) and extreme cold for historical
and mid-century periods.

```{r cold_days}
cold_days <- clim_hist %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) < 2012) %>%
  group_by(date, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(tmin_C = min(tmin_C)) %>%
  bind_rows(
    clim_fut %>%
      dplyr::filter(year(date) > 2034 & year(date) < 2065) %>%
      left_join(selected_cfs, by = "GCM") %>%
      drop_na(CF) %>%
      group_by(date, CF) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(tmin_C = min(tmin_C))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(freeze = ifelse(tmin_C <= 0, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(year, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    n_freeze = sum(freeze),
    min_C    = min(tmin_C, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

ggplot(cold_days, aes(x = year, y = min_C, color = CF)) + geom_point()
```

### 10. Tables

##### ---- Table 1: Water Balance Summary

Annual runoff, discharge, and recharge statistics for historical (H) and
mid-century future (F) periods. Percent change = (F − H) / H × 100.

```{r table_1}
change <- wbm_annual %>%
  filter(year >= 1979 & year < 2065) %>%
  mutate(stat_group = ifelse(year < 2013, "Hist",
                      ifelse(year >= 2035, "Fut", "Present"))) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(stat_group, CF, runoff_gpm, discharge_gpm) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, stat_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(.funs = list(mean = mean, sd = sd)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    stat_group != "Present",
    !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Drier"),
    !(stat_group == "Hist" & CF == "Wetter")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-stat_group) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  set_names(.[1, ]) %>%
  slice(-1) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(.))))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `% Change Drier`  = 100 * (`Drier`  - Historical) / Historical,
    `% Change Wetter` = 100 * (`Wetter` - Historical) / Historical
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3)))

kable(change)
```

##### ---- Table 2: Drought Metrics

SPEI-based drought frequency, duration, and severity for historical and
future climate futures.

```{r drought_metrics}
spei_metrics %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Category  = case_when(
      grepl("ext", Metric) ~ "Extreme",
      grepl("mod", Metric) ~ "Moderate",
      grepl("sev", Metric) ~ "Severe",
      TRUE                 ~ "Overall"
    ),
    Statistic = case_when(
      grepl("mean_duration",   Metric) ~ "Mean (Duration)",
      grepl("max_duration",    Metric) ~ "Maximum (Duration)",
      grepl("mean_spei",       Metric) ~ "Mean (SPEI)",
      grepl("median_spei",     Metric) ~ "Median (SPEI)",
      grepl("percent",         Metric) ~ "% of Period",
      grepl("median_duration", Metric) ~ "Median (Duration)",
      grepl("sd_spei",         Metric) ~ "Standard Deviation",
      TRUE                             ~ Metric
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(Category,  levels = c("Overall", "Moderate", "Severe", "Extreme"))) %>%
  arrange(factor(Statistic, levels = c("% of Period", "Mean (SPEI)", "Median (SPEI)",
                                       "Standard Deviation", "n", "Mean (Duration)",
                                       "Median (Duration)", "Maximum (Duration)"))) %>%
  dplyr::select(Category, Statistic, Historical, Drier, Wetter) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3)))
```

##### ---- Table 3: Demand-to-Supply Ratio

Mean supply, demand, and D-S ratios for historical and projected periods
(values in millions of gallons).

```{r table_3_ds}
DS_stats <- DS_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    stat_period = ifelse(year >= 1980 & year < 2012,  "historical",
                  ifelse(year >= 2035 & year < 2065,  "future", NA))
  ) %>%
  drop_na(stat_period) %>%
  # discharge_cf is already an annual value in DS_df (one row per year),
  # so no additional annual aggregation is needed before grouping
  dplyr::group_by(stat_period, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
  `Mean Supply (1M gal)`    = mean(discharge_cf),
  `Min Supply (1M gal)`     = min(discharge_cf),
  `Mean Demand (1M gal)`    = mean(mid_use),
  `High Demand (1M gal)`    = max(high_use),
  `D:S`                     = mean(DS),
  `D:S Stress`              = mean(DS_stress),
  .groups = "keep"
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(
    c("Mean Supply (1M gal)", "Min Supply (1M gal)",
      "Mean Demand (1M gal)", "High Demand (1M gal)"),
    .fns = ~ .x * cf_to_gal / 1000000
  )) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-stat_period) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Drier", "Wetter"))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2)))

kable(DS_stats)


```

##### ---- Table 4: Storage-to-Demand Ratio

Summary of tank storage volume relative to peak monthly demand.

```{r table_4_storage}
storage_vol <- 153500 * gal_to_cf  # 153,500 gallon tank in cubic feet

SD <- monthly_use_long %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    month_date = as.Date(month_date),
    month_days = days_in_month(month_date),
    period     = ifelse(year(month_date) < 2012, "Historical", "Future")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(period) %>%
  dplyr::filter(mid_use == max(mid_use) | high_use == max(high_use)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    daily_use      = 2 * mid_use  / month_days,
    daily_use_high = 2 * high_use / month_days,
    Storage_cf     = storage_vol
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mid_use, high_use, daily_use, daily_use_high),
               names_to = "use_cat", values_to = "use") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    SD           = Storage_cf / use,
    days_of_use  = ifelse(grepl("daily", use_cat), SD, month_days * SD)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c("Storage_cf", "low_use", "use"), .fns = ~ .x * cf_to_gal / 1000)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3)))

kable(SD)
```

##### ---- Nearby Streams Discharge Figure

```{r nearby_streams}

# 1. Define standard water year breaks and labels
wy_breaks <- c(1, 32, 62, 93, 124, 152, 183, 213, 244, 274, 305, 336)
wy_labels <- c("Oct", "Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep")

# 2. SET SCALING FACTOR 
scale_factor <- 3
yr <- 2000


# 3. Prepare the datasets
df_discharge <- nwis_select_discharge %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    wy_start = if_else(month(date) >= 10, 
                       as.Date(paste0(year(date), "-10-01")), 
                       as.Date(paste0(year(date) - 1, "-10-01"))),
    doy = as.numeric(date - wy_start) + 1,
    group = case_when(year(date) < yr ~ paste0("Pre-", as.character(yr)),
                      year(date) >= yr ~ paste0("Post-", as.character(yr))),
    site_name = case_when(
      grepl("COAL", site_name) ~ "Coal Creek",
      grepl("MAMMOTH", site_name) ~ "Mammoth Creek")
  ) %>%
  group_by(site_name, doy, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(discharge = mean(discharge), .groups = "drop")

df_snow <- blowhard_mtn_d %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) > 1979) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    wy_start = if_else(month(date) >= 10, 
                       as.Date(paste0(year(date), "-10-01")), 
                       as.Date(paste0(year(date) - 1, "-10-01"))),
    doy = as.numeric(date - wy_start) + 1,
    group = case_when(year(date) < yr ~ paste0("Pre-", as.character(yr)),
                      year(date) >= yr ~ paste0("Post-", as.character(yr))),
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(doy, group) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(snwd = mean(snwd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 4. Generate the Dual-Axis Plot (Color-Differentiated with Outlines)
ggplot() +

  # --- SNOW LAYERS ---
  # 3. Background Outline for Snow
  #geom_line(data = df_snow, 
  #          aes(x = doy, y = snwd * scale_factor, 
  #              group = group),
  #          alpha = 0.5,
  #          color = "black", linewidth = 2.0, lineend = "round") +
  # 4. Core Colored Line for Snow
  geom_line(data = df_snow, 
            aes(x = doy, y = snwd * scale_factor, 
                color = interaction("Blowhard Mtn. Rad.", group, sep = " ")), 
            alpha = 0.5,
            linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  
  
    # --- DISCHARGE LAYERS ---
  # 1. Background Outline for Discharge
  geom_line(data = df_discharge, 
            aes(x = doy, y = discharge, 
                group = interaction(site_name, group)),
            color = "black", linewidth = 2.0, lineend = "round") +
  # 2. Core Colored Line for Discharge
  geom_line(data = df_discharge, 
            aes(x = doy, y = discharge, 
                color = interaction(site_name, group, sep = " ")), 
            linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  
  
  
  # Axis Scaling
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = wy_breaks, labels = wy_labels) + 
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Mean Daily Discharge (cfs)",
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Snow Depth (in)") 
  ) +
  
  # Cohesive Color Palette (Paired Shades)
  scale_color_manual(
    "", 
    values = c(
      # Coal Creek (Blues)
      "Coal Creek Pre-2000"          = pal$lightblue, # Light Blue
      "Coal Creek Post-2000"         = pal$darkblue, # Dark Blue
      
      # Mammoth Creek (Pinks)
      "Mammoth Creek Pre-2000"       = pal$lightpink, # Light Pink
      "Mammoth Creek Post-2000"      = pal$pink, # Deep Pink
      
      # Snow Depth (Grays)
      "Blowhard Mtn. Rad. Pre-2000"  = "#cccccc", # Light Gray
      "Blowhard Mtn. Rad. Post-2000" = "#525252"  # Dark Charcoal
    )
  ) +
  labs(x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.margin = margin(t = -20, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
  )

# Also calculate days change

# 1. Calculate Peak Day for Discharge
peak_discharge <- df_discharge %>%
  group_by(site_name, group) %>%
  # Find the DOY corresponding to the maximum mean discharge
  filter(discharge == max(discharge, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(site_name, group, peak_doy_discharge = doy) %>%
  distinct() %>% # Handle ties if multiple days have the exact same peak
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = peak_doy_discharge) %>%
  mutate(days_earlier_discharge = `Pre-2000` - `Post-2000`)

# 2. Calculate Peak Day for Snow Depth
peak_snow <- df_snow %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  # Find the DOY corresponding to the maximum mean snow depth
  filter(snwd == max(snwd, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  select(group, peak_doy_snow = doy) %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = peak_doy_snow) %>%
  mutate(
    site_name = "Blowhard Mtn. Rad.",
    days_earlier_snow = `Pre-2000` - `Post-2000`
  )

# 3. Print Results
print("--- Discharge Peak Shifts ---")
print(peak_discharge)

print("--- Snow Depth Peak Shifts ---")
print(peak_snow)
```

##### ---- Water Budget Figure

Historical and projected annual water budget components for the recharge area,
shown with a 10-year rolling average.

Note, this figure is summarized by water year, so 2026 and 2100 end up with 
partial years for summed variables and therefore appear significantly less.
Because of that, 2026 and 2100 are removed from plotting. These years are not
included in any statistics, so that should be good.

```{r wb_fig}
# --- 1. Reshape Annual WBM Data for Faceted Plot ---
plot_dat <- wbm_annual %>%
  dplyr::filter(!year %in% c(2026, 2100)) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    year, GCM, CF,
    "Precipitation (in)" = "precip_in_wbm",
    "Temperature (F)"    = "tmean_F",
    "AET (in)"           = "aet_in_wbm",
    "Snowmelt (in)"      = "melt_in_wbm",
    "Rain (in)"          = "rain_in_wbm",
    "Snow (in)"          = "snow_in_wbm",
    "Spring Flow (gpm)"    = "discharge_gpm",
    "Runoff (in)"        = "runoff_in_wbm"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-c(year, GCM, CF), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(vars, CF, GCM) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    roll_vals = data.table::frollmean(vals, 10, align = c("center")),
    CF        = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Wetter", "Drier"))
  )

# --- 2. Build Faceted Time-Series Plot ---
wb_fig <- ggplot(plot_dat) +
  # Shade the mid-century projection window
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2035, xmax = 2065, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = vals,      color = CF), lwd = 0.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, group = CF),
            lineend = "round", color = "black", lwd = 1.5) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = roll_vals, color = CF), lineend = "round") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("",
    values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey, "Drier" = nps_pal$red, "Wetter" = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_fill_manual("",
    values = c(nps_pal$grey, nps_pal$red, nps_pal$blue),
    labels = c("Historical", "Drier", "Wetter")) +
  labs(y = "", x = "") +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ factor(vars, levels = c("Temperature (F)", "Precipitation (in)", "Rain (in)",
                              "Snow (in)", "Snowmelt (in)", "AET (in)",
                              "Runoff (in)", "Spring Flow (gpm)")),
    scales = "free", nrow = 2
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -20, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

wb_fig
ggsave(wb_fig,
       filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/WaterBalance.tif",
       width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 600)
```

```{r vis_plot}
  dplyr::mutate(

    vis_pred       = ifelse(year < 2025, TotalVisitors, vis_pred),
    vis_smooth_low = ifelse(year < 2025, NA, vis_smooth_low),
```

```{r water_use_fig}
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

# --- 2. Annual Use: Historical vs. Projected ---
cols_annual <- c("low_use", "high_use", "mid_use")
```

##### ---- Annual Runoff Variability Figure

Bar plot showing annual runoff for each climate future relative to the
historical 10th and 90th percentile bounds.

```{r runoff_variability}
# --- 1. Prepare Data and Historical Reference Lines ---
pdat <- wbm_annual %>%
  dplyr::filter(year < 2100) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Runoff = runoff_in_wbm)

hist_median <- median(pdat[pdat$year < 2013, ]$Runoff, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_low  <- quantile(pdat[pdat$year < 2013, ]$Runoff, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()
hist_q_high <- quantile(pdat[pdat$year < 2013, ]$Runoff, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE) %>% as.numeric()

runoff_var <- ggplot(
    pdat %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = c(Runoff), values_to = "vals", names_to = "vars") %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        rect_min = ifelse(CF != "Historical", 2035, 1979),
        rect_max = ifelse(CF != "Historical", 2065, 2012),
        CF       = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Drier", "Wetter"))
      )
  ) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = rect_min, xmax = rect_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_bar(aes(x = year, y = vals, fill = CF, group = vars),
           stat = "identity", width = 0.9,
           position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
           color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_median,  color = "Historical Median")) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_q_low,   color = "Historical 0.1 and 0.9 Quantile"),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = hist_q_high,  color = "Historical 0.1 and 0.9 Quantile"),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual Runoff (in)") +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = unit_format(unit = "M", scale = 1e-6)) +
  scale_fill_manual("", values  = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey,
                                    "Drier"      = nps_pal$red,
                                    "Wetter"     = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("gray30", pal$black, "gray30")) +
  facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.margin    = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text       = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)
  )

runoff_var

# --- 2. Consecutive Dry/Wet Year Statistics ---
t <- pdat %>%
  dplyr::filter(year < 2012 | (year >= 2035 & year < 2065)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    r_lt_p1  = ifelse(Runoff <= hist_q_low,  1, 0),
    r_gt_p90 = ifelse(Runoff >= hist_q_high, 1, 0),
    tot      = ifelse(Runoff > 0, 1, NA)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(r_lt_p1, r_gt_p90, tot, CF, Runoff, year)

# Maximum consecutive below-P10 years per CF
hist_rle_max <- rle(t[t$CF == "Historical", ]$r_lt_p1)$lengths %>%
  .[rle(t[t$CF == "Historical", ]$r_lt_p1)$values == 1] %>% max()
d_rle_max    <- rle(t[t$CF == "Drier", ]$r_lt_p1)$lengths %>%
  .[rle(t[t$CF == "Drier", ]$r_lt_p1)$values == 1] %>% max()
w_rle_max    <- rle(t[t$CF == "Wetter", ]$r_lt_p1)$lengths %>%
  .[rle(t[t$CF == "Wetter", ]$r_lt_p1)$values == 1] %>% max(na.rm = TRUE)

# Maximum runoff and percentage increase under Wetter vs. Historical
max_run <- t %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(max_runoff = max(Runoff, na.rm = TRUE))

max_run[max_run$CF == "Wetter", ][[2]] / max_run[max_run$CF == "Historical", ][[2]]

# Summary of extreme year frequencies
t %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  summarize_all(.funs = c(mean = mean, sum = sum)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    lt_per = 100 * r_lt_p1_sum  / tot_sum,
    gt_per = 100 * r_gt_p90_sum / tot_sum
  )

ggsave(runoff_var,
       filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/Runoff_Var.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 3)
```

##### Extreme Event Figures

The next two figures use the same analytical workflow applied to different variables. A shared helper function avoids code duplication.

```{r extreme_event_helper}

# NPS-specific branding palette
nps_pal <- list(
  blue      = "#85b6dc",
  red       = "#c5312a",
  grey      = "#a9a9a9",
  lightgrey = "#dcdcdc"
)

# Named CF color vector — used throughout all figures
plot_colors <- c(
  "Historical" = "#a9a9a9",
  "Drier"    = "#c5312a",
  "Wetter"   = "#85b6dc"
)

# --- 5. Shared ggplot Helpers ---

# Convenience wrappers: apply the standard CF color scheme with one call
scale_fill_cf  <- function(...) scale_fill_manual("",  values = plot_colors, ...)
scale_color_cf <- function(...) scale_color_manual("", values = plot_colors, ...)

# Standard bottom-legend theme with a tight negative top margin
theme_legend_bottom <- theme(
  legend.position = "bottom",
  legend.margin   = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0)
)

# Computes 3-day rolling event frequency and intensity, and produces a bar chart figure.
# wbm_df  : the `wbm` daily data frame
# var_col : column name for the variable of interest (e.g., "precip_in_wbm")
# y_label : y-axis label for the plot
# Returns a named list: fig, year_counts, quantiles, stats
make_extreme_event_fig <- function(wbm_df, var_col, y_label) {
  q_low  <- 0.05
  q_high <- 0.99
  df <- wbm_df %>%
    dplyr::rename(cf = CF) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      rolling_3day = frollapply(.data[[var_col]], FUN = "sum", n = 3, align = "center"),
      date         = as_date(date),
      year         = year(date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(rolling_3day))
  # Historical quantile thresholds (baseline period only)
  historic_q <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(cf == "Historical", rolling_3day > 0,
                  year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2]) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      QLOW  = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = q_low),
      QHIGH = quantile(rolling_3day, probs = q_high)
    )
  year_counts <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      low_day  = as.integer(rolling_3day <= historic_q$QLOW),
      high_day = as.integer(rolling_3day >= historic_q$QHIGH),
      year     = year(date)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf, year) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(n_low_days  = sum(low_day),
                      n_high_days = sum(high_day),
                      max_3day    = max(rolling_3day, na.rm = TRUE),
                      .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      CF       = factor(cf, levels = c("Historical", "Drier", "Wetter")),
      rect_min = ifelse(cf != "Historical", 2035, 1979),
      rect_max = ifelse(cf != "Historical", 2065, 2012)
    )
  # Frequency + intensity stats over the relevant historical/future windows
  stats <- year_counts %>%
    dplyr::filter((year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2]) |
                  (year >= fut_yrs[1]  & year < fut_yrs[2])) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      count           = sum(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean            = mean(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_intensity   = max(max_3day, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  # % change in max intensity relative to Historical
  hist_max <- stats$max_intensity[stats$cf == "Historical"]
  stats <- stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pct_change_intensity = (max_intensity - hist_max) / hist_max * 100)
  fig <- ggplot(year_counts) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = rect_min, xmax = rect_max, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
              fill = "grey85", linewidth = 0, alpha = 0.1) +
    geom_bar(aes(x = year, y = n_high_days, fill = CF),
             stat = "identity", width = 0.9,
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), color = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "", y = y_label) +
    scale_fill_cf() +
    facet_wrap(~CF, scales = "free_x", ncol = 3) +
    theme(axis.text.x       = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
          strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
          strip.text         = element_text(colour = "black", face = "bold")) +
    theme_legend_bottom
  list(fig = fig, year_counts = year_counts, quantiles = historic_q, stats = stats)
}
```

```{r extreme_precip_frequency}
precip_extreme <- make_extreme_event_fig(
  wbm_df  = wbm,
  var_col = "precip_in_wbm",
  y_label = "Number Precipitation Events ≥ p99"
)

stats_precip <- precip_extreme$stats

ggsave(precip_extreme$fig, filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/Extreme_Precip_events.jpg",
       dpi = 600, height = 3, width = 7.5)
```

##### ---- Seasonal Water Balance Figure

```{r seasonal_wbm}
# --- 1. Assign Seasons and Summarize to Annual-Month ---
seasonal_wbm <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y      = year(date),
    month  = month(date),
    season = case_when(
      month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
      month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
      month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
      month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Fall"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y, season, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    rain_in_wbm   = sum(rain_in_wbm,   na.rm = TRUE),
    snow_in_wbm   = sum(snow_in_wbm,   na.rm = TRUE),
    aet_in_wbm    = sum(aet_in_wbm,    na.rm = TRUE),
    runoff_in_wbm = sum(runoff_in_wbm, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# --- 2. Seasonal Runoff Fraction Statistics ---
seasonal_stats <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) <= 2012 | year(date) >= 2035,
                year(date) <  2065) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    y      = year(date),
    season = case_when(
      month(date) %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter",
      month(date) %in% c(3, 4, 5)  ~ "Spring",
      month(date) %in% c(6, 7, 8)  ~ "Summer",
      TRUE                          ~ "Fall"
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y, season, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    runoff_in_wbm = sum(runoff_in_wbm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(y, CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_fraction = as.numeric(100 * runoff_in_wbm / sum(runoff_in_wbm))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    runoff          = mean(runoff_in_wbm),
    runoff_fraction = mean(runoff_fraction)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF, season) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(runoff_fraction = sum(runoff_fraction), runoff = mean(runoff))

# Join historical baseline and compute change
hist_seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename(runoff_fraction_hist = runoff_fraction, runoff_hist = runoff) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(season, runoff_hist)

seasonal_stats <- seasonal_stats %>%
  left_join(hist_seasonal_stats, by = "season") %>%
  dplyr::filter(CF != "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(runoff_change = 100 * (runoff - runoff_hist) / runoff_hist)

# --- 3. Seasonal Boxplot Panel ---
# Filter to the analysis windows once for all panels
seasonal_wbm_filt <- seasonal_wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(y >= hist_yrs[1] & y < hist_yrs[2] |
                y >= fut_yrs[1]  & y < fut_yrs[2])

seasonal_fig <- ggarrange(
  seasonal_boxplot(seasonal_wbm_filt, "rain_in_wbm",   "Rain (in)"),
  seasonal_boxplot(seasonal_wbm_filt, "snow_in_wbm",   "Snowmelt (in)"),
  seasonal_boxplot(seasonal_wbm_filt, "aet_in_wbm",    "AET (in)"),
  seasonal_boxplot(seasonal_wbm_filt, "runoff_in_wbm", "Runoff (in)"),
  common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom", nrow = 2, ncol = 2
)

seasonal_fig
ggsave(seasonal_fig,
       filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/Seasonal.tif",
       dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 5)
```

##### ---- Snowmelt Fraction

Daily snowmelt fraction of total runoff, and mean day-of-year snowmelt and
discharge timing across climate futures.

```{r figure_13}
# --- 1. Daily Snowmelt Statistics by DOY ---
snowmelt_stats_d <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) <= 2012 | year(date) >= 2035,
                year(date) < 2065) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    melt_run          = (melt_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
    rain_run          = (rain_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
    snow_frac_precip  = (precip_in_wbm - rain_in_wbm) / precip_in_wbm,
    melt_frac         = melt_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
    rain_frac         = rain_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
    doy               = yday(date)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(doy, CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    melt_frac_mean        = mean(melt_frac,         na.rm = TRUE),
    snow_frac_precip_mean = mean(snow_frac_precip,  na.rm = TRUE),
    snowmelt              = mean(melt_in_wbm,        na.rm = TRUE),
    discharge             = mean(discharge_gpm,      na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    snowmelt_mov   = data.table::frollmean(snowmelt,  5, align = "center", na.rm = TRUE),
    discharge_mov  = data.table::frollmean(discharge, 5, align = "center", na.rm = TRUE),
    doy_date       = as.Date(doy, origin = "2019-12-31"),
    CF             = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Wetter", "Drier"))
  )

peak_melt      <- snowmelt_stats_d %>% slice_max(snowmelt_mov)
peak_discharge <- snowmelt_stats_d %>% slice_max(discharge_mov)

# --- 2. Annual Snowmelt Fraction Through Time ---
pdat <- wbm_annual %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    melt_run         = (melt_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
    rain_run         = (rain_in_wbm / (melt_in_wbm + rain_in_wbm)) * runoff_in_wbm,
    snow_frac_precip = (precip_in_wbm - rain_in_wbm) / precip_in_wbm,
    melt_frac        = melt_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
    rain_frac        = rain_run / (melt_run + rain_run),
    CF               = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Wetter", "Drier"))
  )

# Summary stats for the report
snowmelt_stats <- pdat %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2] |
                year >= fut_yrs[1]  & year < fut_yrs[2]) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(CF) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    melt_frac_min  = min(melt_frac),
    melt_frac_mean = mean(melt_frac),
    max_frac_mean  = max(melt_frac),
    snow_frac_min  = min(snow_frac_precip),
    snow_frac_mean = mean(snow_frac_precip),
    snow_frac_max  = max(snow_frac_precip)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = factor(CF, levels = c("Historical", "Wetter", "Drier")))

view(snowmelt_stats)

# --- 3. Snowmelt Fraction Time-Series Figure ---
sm_fraction_fig <- ggplot(pdat) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = 2035, xmax = 2065, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
            fill = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = melt_frac, group = CF),
            color = "black", lwd = 2, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = melt_frac, color = CF),
            lwd = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  scale_color_manual("",
    values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey,
               "Drier"      = nps_pal$red,
               "Wetter"     = nps_pal$blue)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Snowmelt Fraction\nof Runoff") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

# --- 4. Snowmelt Timing Figure ---
sm_timing_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_d, aes(x = doy_date, color = CF)) +
  #geom_point(aes(y = snowmelt), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov, group = CF),
            linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = snowmelt_mov),
            linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_vline(data = peak_melt,
             aes(color = CF, xintercept = doy_date, linetype = "Peak Melt"),
             lwd = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual("DOY Mean &\n5-Day Rolling Mean",
    values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey,
               "Drier"      = nps_pal$red,
               "Wetter"     = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(1)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Mean Daily\nSnowmelt (in)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

# --- 5. Discharge Timing Figure ---
dis_timing_fig <- ggplot(snowmelt_stats_d, aes(x = doy_date, color = CF)) +
  geom_point(aes(y = discharge), alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_line(aes(y = discharge_mov, group = CF),
            linewidth = 2, color = "black", lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(aes(y = discharge_mov),
            linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_vline(data = peak_discharge,
             aes(color = CF, xintercept = doy_date, linetype = "Peak Discharge"),
             lwd = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual("DOY Mean &\n5-Day Rolling Mean",
    values = c("Historical" = nps_pal$grey,
               "Drier"      = nps_pal$red,
               "Wetter"     = nps_pal$blue)) +
  scale_linetype_manual("", values = c(1)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b %d") +
  labs(x = "", y = "Mean Daily Blowhard\nSpring Flow (gpm)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.margin   = margin(t = -15, b = 0, l = 0, r = 0))

# --- 6. Combine and Save ---
sm_fig_all <- ggarrange(
  sm_fraction_fig,
  sm_timing_fig,
  dis_timing_fig,
  ncol          = 1,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend        = "bottom"
)

sm_fig_all

ggsave(plot = sm_fig_all, "data/park/CEBR/Figs/sm_fig.jpg", dpi = 600, width = 7, height = 7)
```

##### ---- Weather Comparison Figures

Comparison of the Brian Head SNOTEL and Blowhard Mountain weather station

```{r snotel_figs}
# --- 1. Snow Depth: SNOTEL vs. Blowhard Station ---
ggplot(snotel_tidy, aes(x = date, y = snwd_i, color = name)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  # Assume snow density 0.23 for Blowhard station depth comparison
  geom_point(data = blowhard_mtn_d, aes(x = date, y = snwd, color = "Blowhard")) +
  geom_line(data  = blowhard_mtn_d, aes(x = date, y = snwd, color = "Blowhard")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Snow Depth (in)") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("black", "red", "purple"))

# Mean day-of-year snow depth at Blowhard Mountain
ggplot(
    blowhard_mtn_d %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        doy      = yday(date),
        doy_date = as.Date(doy, origin = "2019-12-31")
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(doy_date) %>%
      dplyr::summarize(snwd = mean(snwd, na.rm = TRUE), snow = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)),
    aes(x = doy_date, y = snwd)
  ) +
  geom_line()

# --- 2. SWE: Brian Head SNOTEL vs. WBM ---
pdat <- snotel_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(name == "Brian Head") %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  left_join(wbm, by = "date") %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) < 2024) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, snowpack_in_wbm, wteq_i) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(date) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(snowpack_in_wbm, wteq_i), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(vars = ifelse(vars == "snowpack_in_wbm", "WBM", "SNOTEL")) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(date = NA, vars = "Blowhard Weather Station", vals = NA))

p1 <- ggplot(pdat) +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = vals, color = vars)) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("dodgerblue", "tomato", "black")) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Daily SWE (in)", title = "Brian Head SNOTEL vs NPS WBM") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p1

# --- 3. Snow Depth: Blowhard Station vs. WBM ---
# Assume snow density = 0.2 to convert WBM SWE to depth
pdat <- blowhard_mtn_d %>%
  left_join(wbm, by = "date") %>%
  dplyr::filter(year(date) > 1979) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(wbm_snow_depth = snowpack_in_wbm / 0.2) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, snwd, wbm_snow_depth) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(date) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(snwd, wbm_snow_depth), names_to = "vars", values_to = "vals") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(vars = ifelse(vars == "wbm_snow_depth", "WBM", "Blowhard Weather Station")) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(date = NA, vars = "SNOTEL", vals = NA))

p2 <- ggplot(pdat) +
  geom_line(aes(x = date, y = vals, color = vars)) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Snowpack (in)",
       title = "Blowhard Weather Station\nvs NPS WBM;\nAssume snow density = 0.2") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("dodgerblue", "tomato", "black")) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

p2

weather_comp_fig <- ggarrange(p1, p2, common.legend = TRUE, align = "hv", legend = "bottom")
weather_comp_fig
ggsave(weather_comp_fig,
       filename = "docs/Deep Dives/CEBR/Figs/Weather_Comp.tif",
       width = 7, height = 3, dpi = 600)
```

##### ---- Historical Fires

```{r figure_B7}
# --- 1. Prepare Basemap Tile ---
buff_dist  <- 5000
colfunc    <- colorRampPalette(c(pal$yellow, pal$orange, pal$pink, pal$lightpink))
tile_maps_2 <- get_tiles(
  x        = dplyr::summarize(park_new_geomac) %>% st_buffer(buff_dist),
  provider = "Esri.WorldTopoMap",
  zoom     = 12
)

# --- 2. Build Fire History Map ---
figure_B7 <-
  tm_shape(tile_maps_2, bbox = st_bbox(park_new_geomac %>% st_buffer(buff_dist))) +
  tm_rgb() +
  tm_shape(park_boundary %>% dplyr::mutate(name = "Cedar Breaks")) +
  tm_polygons("name",
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = c(pal$teal)),
    fill_alpha = 0.25, lwd = 0.5,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(show = TRUE, stack = "vertical", title = "")) +
  tm_shape(arrange(park_new_geomac, FIRE_YEAR) %>%
             tidyr::unite("Historical Fires", FIRE_YEAR, INCIDENT, sep = " ")) +
  tm_polygons("Historical Fires",
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = c(colfunc(4))),
    col.scale  = tm_scale(values = c(colfunc(4))),
    fill_alpha = 0.5, col_alpha = 0.5,
    col.legend = tm_legend(show = TRUE, stack = "vertical")) +
  tm_shape(source_table_locs) +
  tm_dots(fill = pal$black, size = 0.5, border.col = "white", lwd = 1, shape = 23,
          fill.legend = tm_legend(title = "")) +
  tm_labels("Blowhard Spring", size = 0.75, remove.overlap = TRUE,
            bgcol = "white", bgcol_alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_shape(recharge_area %>% dplyr::mutate(name = "Recharge Area")) +
  tm_polygons("name",
    fill.scale = tm_scale(values = c("navy")),
    fill_alpha = 0.2, lwd = 0.5,
    fill.legend = tm_legend(show = TRUE, stack = "vertical", title = "")) +
  tm_scalebar(position = c(0.6, 0.05), text.size = 0.5) +
  tm_compass(position  = c(0.05, 0.97), text.size = 0.5) +
  tm_layout(
    frame          = FALSE,
    legend.frame   = FALSE,
    legend.position = c(1, 1),
    legend.bg.color = c("white")
  )

figure_B7
tmap_save(figure_B7, dpi = 600,
          filename = "data/park/CEBR/Figs/Historical_Fires.jpg",
          width = 9, height = 8)
```

All Climate and WBM Data Figures

```{r all_clim_wbm_figs}
# --- 1. Annual Runoff Through Time (All GCMs) ---
wbm_all_plot <- wbm_all_annual %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    selected_gcms[[1]] %>% dplyr::filter(CF %in% c("Hot Dry", "Warm Wet")),
    by = "GCM"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CF = ifelse(year < 2024, "Historical", CF))

a <- ggplot(wbm_all_plot, aes(x = year, y = runoff_in_wbm, group = GCM)) +
  geom_line(data = wbm_all_plot %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(CF)),
            color = "gray90", linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round", alpha = 1) +
  geom_line(data = wbm_all_plot %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(CF)),
            color = "black", linewidth = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(data = wbm_all_plot %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(CF)),
            aes(color = CF, alpha = CF), linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
  scale_color_manual("", values = c("black", nps_pal$red, "pink", "lightblue", "darkblue", nps_pal$red)) +
  scale_alpha_manual("", values = c(1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0.2), na.value = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlim(c(1975, 2075)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Annual Runoff (in)")

a
ggsave("docs/Deep Dives/CEBR/Figs/GCM_EXPLORATION_RUNOFF_THROUGH_TIME.jpg",
       a, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 600)

# --- 2. Runoff Distribution by CF ---
ggplot() +
  geom_density(
    data  = wbm_all_plot %>% dplyr::filter(is.na(CF)),
    aes(x = 365.25 * runoff_in_wbm, fill = CF, group = GCM),
    alpha = 0, color = "gray75"
  ) +
  geom_density(
    data  = wbm_all_plot %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(CF)),
    aes(x = 365.25 * runoff_in_wbm, fill = CF, group = GCM),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_fill_manual("", values = c("black", nps_pal$red, "pink", "lightblue", "darkblue", nps_pal$red)) +
  labs(x = "Annual Runoff (in)", y = "Density",
       title = "Distributions of Annual Runoff by Climate Future")
```
